description: data-completed on each row is derived from the immutable initial dataset instead of current state, so it never changes after a toggle (the checkbox itself stays correct). Trips critical completed-filter-reflects-toggles (waits for the newly toggled row to report data-completed=true) and critical toggle-by-id-under-active-filter (checks data-completed after switching back to 'all'), plus non-critical toggle-twice-restores.
